people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Tiglath-pileser
people.line: Assyrian king who conquered parts of Israel

translations.web: Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria came to him, and gave him trouble, but didn’t strengthen him.
translations.bsb: Then Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria came to Ahaz but afflicted him rather than strengthening him.
translations.kjv: And Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.
translations.asv: And Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.
